keyPoints: Private sections enforce per-item read access: only the item's author can view it; wrong-owner requests return 404 instead of 403
Private sections require authentication for all operations, including reads, aligning with ownership-based visibility rules
Legacy items without stamped author_email remain accessible to any allowlisted writer, ensuring backward compatibility
HistoryApiStorage backend enables version-history operations, including optimistic concurrency checks for create, update, and delete
architecture.overview: Azure Functions v2 app (Python) deployed to a Consumption plan. Each HTTP trigger handles one REST operation. Content is organized into named sections, each with its own schema, visibility rules, and storage backend. The default storage backends are GitHub and Azure Blob Storage, with optional integration to [[posts-api|history-api]] for version-history functionality. Auth uses google-auth to validate Google ID tokens server-side; no session state is maintained. Private sections now enforce authentication and ownership checks for all operations, including reads.

dataFlow.label: Ownership / allowlist check
sublines: POST: email must be in ALLOWED_WRITERS
PUT/DELETE: requester must match author_email (or be in allowlist for legacy items)
Private sections require allowlist membership for all operations, including reads
Private-section reads: requester must match author_email; wrong-owner requests return 404

dataFlow.label: Version-history operations
sublines: GET /versions: mirrors get_item visibility rules (private sections require auth + allowlist + author match)
GET /versions/{version_id}: retrieves a specific version of an item
GET /versions/{v1}/diff/{v2}: computes a diff between two versions of an item

description: A serverless write API for quixotry.me's content sections. Items are stored as files with YAML frontmatter committed directly to GitHub; the API provides a unified interface for managing these sections.
features: Restrict private-section reads to the item's own author; other authors' entries are excluded
Private sections return 404 for wrong-owner requests, avoiding confirmation of item existence
Private sections require authentication for all operations, including reads
Legacy item support: items without author_email remain visible to any allowlisted writer
Version-history support: list, retrieve, and diff versions of content items via [[posts-api|history-api]]
role: Manages content sections (writing, diary) stored on GitHub
summary: Azure Functions (Python) API that manages content sections, such as markdown blog posts, stored as files in a GitHub repository. Authentication is handled via Google ID tokens; content ownership is enforced per-creator, with an allowlist controlling who can write. Private sections now require authentication for all operations, including reads.
title: posts-api
